summary:
AP-7（PCVM/Test guard opt-in wiring）：注入机制 + propagation + 并发安全已（自）验证就绪，但**质量运行触发判定真正欠定，须控制器/Design 决策**。无代码改动（不擅自做改变用户可见行为的过宽接线），工作树净，HEAD 016f6bb。

【注入机制（就绪）】per-run guard opt-in = AgentRunInput.execution.groundingEnforcement（AP-3 通道）。主体注入点= **session 级**：SessionExecutionBuilder.ts:111 buildBootstrapSessionRunInput（当前不传 execution，默认取 children[0]）/ AgentRunInputBuilders.ts:141·198·254。propagation 端到端通（AlembicAgent 只读核验，AP-0/FC3 佐证）：execution.groundingEnforcement→AgentService.buildRuntimeOptions:187→runtime.execute:97→AgentRuntime.#groundingEnforcement:259→LoopContext:597→#processTextResponse:1605 guard 短路（ctx.groundingEnforcement==='guard' 才调 evaluateAnalyzeTextGroundingGate）。

【并发核查（必做项·结论=SAFE·自验）】bootstrap-session 并发由 AgentRunCoordinator 服务层处理：agentService.run(sessionInput)→partition→runChildren Promise.all（AgentRunCoordinator:85）→每子维度递归 agentService.run(childInput)（AgentService:61）→各 runtimeBuilder.build() 建**独立 AgentRuntime**（AgentService:81）再 runtime.execute（:97）。故 #groundingEnforcement/startTime/tokenUsage **每子维度隔离、不串值**——无 per-run 状态竞争。partitioner 把 parent.execution 原样拷给所有 child（AgentRunCoordinator:366）⇒ session 级 groundingEnforcement 均匀传播全维度（session 级语义、安全）。初步'FanOutStrategy 共享单实例串值'假设=**证伪**（bootstrap-session 走 coordinator 每子建新 runtime，非 within-runtime fanout）。

【触发判定欠定（BLOCKER·须决策）】AP-0/FC4 已证'PCVM/Test 无 TS 消费（仅 markdown skill）'——主体**无**区分'PCVM/Test 质量运行'的代码信号；全仓**无** grounding/guard 配置开关；唯一 session 级 run-type 信号= pipelineMode（preparation.view.mode：'bootstrap'|'rescan'）/ isIncremental。把 guard 接到 rescan/incremental 会**过宽**：guard=恢复 analyze grounding 阻断+nudge+rollback，改变**普通用户 rescan/增量运行**可见行为，超出设计'guard 仅限 PCVM/Test 质量运行'（doc line 87-88/137-139/243-244）、未授权（违反最高停止卡：改可见行为须确认）。仅加'默认 off 无真实激活者'的管道=设计 line37 禁止的'空开关'。⇒ 两难不可在本窗内单方消解。

【裁定/建议】无安全的代码级 PCVM/Test 触发；正解=显式 per-invocation opt-in。请控制器/Design 三选一：(A) 定义 PCVM/Test 验证流进程内发起 bootstrap 时传 groundingEnforcement='guard' 的明确通道/上下文标志（最贴设计；需补 PCVM/Test 如何发起——FC4 只给机制未给触发源）；(B) 确认 rescan（或子模式 controller-authorized-gap-fill）即设计意图质量运行、接受其 guard 行为变化；(C) config 门禁式 opt-in。任一确认后 AP-7 接线= SessionExecutionBuilder 一处小改（加可选 groundingEnforcement 入参→session execution），可即时落地+端到端验证。

【边界】未碰 AlembicAgent（只读）；未改 PcvNodeEvidence.ts（AP-6）；零代码改动=零行为变更；AlembicCore 不动。

concurrency conclusion self-verified by direct read of AlembicAgent AgentService.ts (45/61/81/97) + AgentRunCoordinator.ts (44/56/85/103/366) — each concurrent dimension gets an independent AgentRuntime; per-run instance state isolated; NOT shared/raced.

risks: DECISION REQUIRED (blocker): which production run is a 'PCVM/Test quality run' that should enable guard? No code-level PCVM/Test signal exists (PCVM/Test = markdown skills, no TS path per AP-0/FC4). The only session-level proxies (pipelineMode='rescan', isIncremental) are TOO BROAD — wiring guard there enables grounding-enforcement block/nudge/rollback for normal user rescans/incremental runs, a user-visible behavior change beyond the design's 'guard only for PCVM/Test' scope. Recommend option (A) explicit per-invocation opt-in; controller/Design to choose A/B/C.

Completion definition NOT met by design: 'non-empty switch' requires ≥1 wired production quality-run path enabling guard (design line 37); a default-off plumbed channel alone would be the forbidden empty switch. Hence cannot self-complete without the trigger decision.

Concurrency model: SAFE for the bootstrap-session path (independent per-child runtimes). NOTE: this relies on the bootstrap-session profile using the AgentRunCoordinator partitioner path (verified for profile 'bootstrap-session'); if a future profile runs multiple execute() on a single shared runtime concurrently, per-run instance fields (incl. groundingEnforcement) would race — out of AP-7 scope but recorded as a structural caveat.
